description: Header file defining the gl::Renderbuffer class and related classes for managing OpenGL renderbuffer objects, including their state, storage, and attachment details.

classes.name: RenderbufferState
classes.description: Manages the state of a renderbuffer, including size, format, samples, and initialization state.

classes.name: Renderbuffer
classes.description: Represents an OpenGL renderbuffer object, providing methods for storage management, attachment, and querying properties.

methods.name: setStorage
methods.description: Allocates storage for the renderbuffer with specified internal format, width, and height.

methods.name: setStorageMultisample
methods.description: Allocates multisample storage for the renderbuffer.

methods.name: setStorageEGLImageTarget
methods.description: Sets the storage of the renderbuffer from an EGL image.

methods.name: getRenderbufferImage
methods.description: Retrieves the image data from the renderbuffer.
